channel.title: Start Now: Tiny Pushes for Getting Started
channel.description:
Very short episodes for the moment you can't make yourself begin. Each one picks one common way people get stuck and walks you to the smallest possible first step, with a short countdown. Made for anyone who finds starting hard, including many people with ADHD. Not medical advice.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Now: ADHD Task Starter, a free iPhone app that shows one task, one small first step and a big start button. No account. Now: ADHD Task Starter on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
